sentence: Raisch and Krakowski define automation as machines taking a task over from a human, and augmentation as humans and machines working on a task together
passage: [Raisch & Krakowski (2021), p. 192] "Whereas automation implies that machines take over a human task, augmentation means that humans collaborate closely with machines to perform a task."

gemini.note: The sentence is a very close paraphrase of the definitions provided in the passage.
